title: Golden hour / low sun
summary: August in Iceland: golden hour lasts half the evening. Don't let the camera neutralize it.
why: Auto white balance sees warm light as a cast and cools it back to neutral — deleting the entire point of the hour. And the meter brightens the moody low light back to midday. Lock WB, bias down a touch.

steps.text: Hold WB, spin rear dial to Daylight — not Auto
Put the focus point where the light lands, not where it comes from

pitfalls: Shooting into the sun drops flare across the frame — shade the front element with your hand just out of frame.
levelUp: Work the light backwards too: turn around. The stuff being lit is often better than the sunset itself.
